QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] Danger is SO Last Week
QuestInfo.0: CONY is living it up on her Maple World vacation, and she's got a special request for you. What could she want? You know it'll be more work, but your curiosity will inevitably get the better of you.
QuestInfo.1: CONY is living it up on her Maple World vacation, and she's got a special request for you. What could she want? You know it'll be more work, but your curiosity will inevitably get the better of you.
QuestInfo.2:
You agreed to bust up multitudes of misguided monsters so CONY and the rest of the LINE FRIENDS can tour Maple World in (mostly) perfect safety.
If you take out #b500 monsters near your level#k each day, you'll receive a LINE FRIENDS Gift Box as a reward.
